segments.comment: Names walk, run and rush commands at the # prompt, alone, after the m prefix, after a count, after F (refused, because the # row lacks CMD_gGF_PREFIX) and before ^A. doextcmd() only runs do_move_*(), do_run_*() or do_rush_*(); cmd.c rhack() 3750-3800 then takes the MOVEMENTCMD row from ge.ext_tlist and calls domove() itself.
